# Synthetic integration fixtures

`rehearsal.json` is deterministic local rehearsal output consumed by replay and viewer regression tests. Actors, approvals and provider transport are synthetic; the Node example program is measured locally. Regenerate after building with `node dist/scripts/integrated-demo-rehearsal.js tests/fixtures/demo/rehearsal.json`. Runtime timings/counters are observations of that local fixture and are not performance promises.

The sibling `integrated-demo-cf-full-step.json` and `integrated-demo-provider-truncation.json` files are generated by `node dist/scripts/generate-provider-fixtures.js`. They preserve provider envelope/encoding and truncation cases with a consistent synthetic checkpoint chain, account, namespace and run. They contain no saved live responses. Tests still refuse malformed envelopes, missing output, changed checkpoint chains, mismatched instances, stale cached descriptors and exhausted budgets.

The read-only presentation example lives at `examples/replay/synthetic-run.json`; its generator replays actual local engine events and measures the generated program. Real application data and execution receipts belong outside the repository.
